findings.summary: The normalization call is gated on `lift.method` being truthy: `lift.method ? normalizeLift(lift) : lift`. This is inverted — normalizeLift already branches internally on presence of `method` (derives a default linear method when absent, parses it when present; see src/domain/methods/normalize.ts:15-18, and its existing unconditional use at src/db/database.ts:37 `lifts.map(normalizeLift)`). As written, legacy lifts with no `method` field — exactly the case the brief calls out ('derives a default method for legacy lifts that predate the method system') — skip normalization entirely and are written to the DB with no method, while lifts that already have a method get redundantly re-parsed. Ran `pnpm vitest run src/db/backup.test.ts`: the implementer's own new test 'a legacy lift (no method) is restored with a derived linear method' fails with `AssertionError: expected undefined to be 'linear'`. The implementer's report claims tests were written and run with no issues, but the suite as committed does not pass. Fix is to call `normalizeLift` unconditionally: `snapshot.lifts.map(normalizeLift)`.
